oliver: Heads up — starting planned edge-router firmware roll in apac1 and eu-west3 on Tue 2026-04-06 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll likely see ~25-35% reduction in inter-region egress headroom during each region's window. Need to coordinate GPU pool drains so we don't trigger cross-region bursts.

sasha: can you paste the runbook link? also which GPU pools are in the first wave? :eyes:

oliver: Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/egress-maint. First-wave pools: `gpu-pool-apac1-hot`, `gpu-pool-euc1-gradient`. Backfill cohorts are C1..C4. Plan: stagger drains 15m apart per cohort, canary 2 nodes first, then ramp.

ben: quick cost note — if we decide to burst to on-demand capacity to avoid client queuing, expect roughly +18% spend for the affected region for the month. Preference: avoid bursting unless latency impact is unacceptable.

jamie: mitigation suggestion: 1) pre-seed KV caches for top tenants in apac1 using `kv-seed --tenants=tenantA,tenantB` before 01:45 UTC, 2) temporarily tighten per-tenant batch size/rate for heavy batch endpoints, 3) promote quantized variant `rw-gpt-medium-q4` for non-critical routes during window.

sasha: I can add rate-limit rules on the API gateway and a console toggle for `route_fallback: slower-variant`. That should reduce cross-region egress from fallback requests.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: canary started at 8234567900, backfill window set to 45m, rollback trigger = p95 latency > 1500ms OR error-rate delta > 1.5x baseline. Notifications -> #incidents if triggers hit.

oliver: timeline recap: canary 02:00 UTC, cohort drains begin 02:15, staggered 15m between cohorts, expected completion 04:00. We'll post short updates in #incidents during the window. Please ack if you own a cohort or have an objection by EOD.

leah: ack — I'll take cohort C2 (gpu-pool-euc1-gradient). I'll run KV re-seed for tenantA and monitor p95 and cross-region egress metrics (net.egress.region to cloudwatch).

jamie: I'll bake the quantized model image and stage it in the console; flag ready to flip within 5m of canary success.

ben: I'll attach a temporary billing tag `maintenance/2026-04-egress-roll` to any burst capacity so we can track delta and revert if >10% spend increase. Also setting alert to notify cost-ops.

oliver: If no objections by EOD we'll proceed. Key action items: pre-seed KV (jamie+leah), rate-limits + fallback (sasha), quantized image + console flag (jamie), cost tag + alerts (ben). Thanks all :thumbsup:
